sentences.en: You should avoid tight fitting clothes if you are pregnant.
sentences.zh: 如果你怀孕了，应该避免穿紧身衣服。

sentences.en: He got the section chief's daughter pregnant and was demoted.
sentences.zh: 他让部门主管的女儿怀孕了，因此被降职。

sentences.en: Why didn't you tell me that this woman was pregnant?
sentences.zh: 你怎么不告诉我那个女人怀孕了？

senses.zh: 重要的，意味深长的：full of meaning；怀孕的：containing offspring
